# AI

Award-Winning AI Built for Employee Relations and Compliance
HR Acuity’s AI employee relations software is the gold standard for defensible, bias-free case management — purpose-built for HR, employee relations and compliance leaders. Trained on two decades of employee relations and investigations best practices, our AI case management software for HR goes beyond automation. It surfaces critical insights, streamlines case analysis and empowers enterprises to act with confidence and consistency to protect what matters most: Your people and your organization.
Smart. Secure. Designed for Compliance.
2025 Brandon Hall Group Excellence Awards Gold Winner in Best Ethical AI & Responsible Technology
Powerful AI Capabilities Built for Employee Relations, HR and Compliance Teams
HR Acuity’s AI provides intelligent capabilities that elevate how teams manage investigations, analyze data and support employees. At the heart of our AI platform is olivER™, your always-on, AI-powered employee relations companion. Trained on HR Acuity’s best practices, benchmarks, templates and workflows built on decades of real-world experience, olivER empowers teams to work faster, smarter and more confidently.
FEATURE OVERVIEW
Our AI-Powered HR Case Management Software Delivers:
Smart Case Insights
Spot trends and risk signals in real time with in-platform data visualizations, so you can identify issues before they escalate.
Airtight Investigation Plans in Seconds
Turn intake notes into a structured, defensible investigation plan in seconds with olivER, boosting speed, consistency and investigator confidence.
Issue Timelines to Spot Gaps Faster
Automatically create a clear timeline from case details and attachments so you can identify conflicts, missing information and follow-up actions early.
Automated Case Summaries
Get clear, factual summaries for every case to ensure leadership alignment, designed to surface what matters without drawing conclusions.
AI-Generated Interview Questions
Leverage interview questions tailored to case context and investigation best practices for deeper, more consistent fact-finding.
Enhanced Benchmarking Suggestions
See how your function compares to peers and get employee relations-specific recommendations to reduce risk and improve outcomes.
Reveal Patterns That Drive Better Decisions
Generate instant charts and summaries that highlight trends, hotspots and patterns across people, cases and time.
Ask Questions About Your Data
Turn complex case trends, performance metrics and workload analytics into digestible insights, so asking questions about your data is as simple as talking to a trusted teammate.
Pre-Loaded Prompts and Best Practices
Use best practice-embedded prompts to streamline tasks, from drafting letters to structuring investigations, to ensure consistency and save time.
Built-In Language Translation
Enable global compliance and employee relations teams to address issues equitably with language translation supported by olivER, directly in platform.
Writing Assistance in Platform
Empower your team to clearly communicate findings, next steps and outcomes with writing support powered by olivER.
PIP Check-In Summaries
Walk into every check-in with instant context. olivER provides managers get a quick recap of prior check-ins, key themes and progress so conversations stay focused.
PIP Goal Drafting
Start PIPs with clearer objectives, faster. olivER drafts SMART-aligned goals using issue details and employee context, with options to regenerate or adjust.
Support You Can Count On
Our award-winning AI keeps your team in the driver’s seat — letting you regenerate responses or dig deeper anytime, with humans always in control.
Answers When You Need Them
olivER finds instant answers to product questions using HR Acuity’s documentation and knowledge base, so your team can keep things moving.
Not All Employee Relations AI Is Created Equal
Imagine this: You’re in a deposition. A plaintiff’s attorney is questioning every detail of your investigation. Can you stand behind it with full confidence, or did AI fill in the blanks for you and draw your conclusions?
This is the risk organizations take when they rely on AI tools that weren’t built for the complexity of employee relations and investigations.
Other AI tools for employee relations promote fast automation and simplified workflows, but speed without structure leads to inconsistent outcomes, biased decisions and increased liability. When AI isn’t trained on proven standards or defensible processes, it leaves you exposed when it matters most. Learn what happens when you get it wrong by watching our recent webinar with plaintiff attorney Lori Deem here.
HR Acuity does AI differently. It never draws conclusions and always keeps your team in the driver’s seat. Count on our AI to give you the data, insights and guidance you need to support defensible, transparent outcomes.
Why High-Performing Teams Trust Our AI
- Software Built for Compliance: Built on nearly 20 years of expertise, our AI is trained for the sensitive, high-stakes work compliance and employee relations teams face every day.
- Unmatched Data Depth: We’ve powered more cases than anyone in the industry, giving us both the volume and quality of data others simply don’t have.
- HR Software That Reduces Bias: Our AI never draws conclusions, makes decisions or uses demographic data to inform recommendations. Our AI is trained on our trusted frameworks, benchmarks and proven best practices to deliver credibility you can count on.
- Real Benchmarks, Real Insights: Our AI is the only one powered by proprietary employee relations benchmark data.
- Complete Confidentiality: Your data is never used to train our models, and we never pull from the open internet. Read our AI Governance Policy to learn more.
Embedded Best Practices and AI-Powered Support in Every Case
olivER delivers fast, trustworthy answers with preloaded prompts to jumpstart your workflow. Trained on HR Acuity support materials, olivER saves your team time and clicks.
Ask olivER Questions Like You Would a Colleague
No more digging through spreadsheets. HR Acuity’s AI-powered employee relations companion, olivER, empowers your team to get the insights you need by asking simple questions like:
- Summarize the top issue categories this quarter.
- Who are the top 5 case owners by duration?
- Show top 10 case locations with average case duration in table form.
- How does case duration vary by case type or status?
- Can you create a bar chart showing case volume by month?
- How many cases were substantiated, unsubstantiated, or inconclusive?
